work.title: Authored revenue-recognition evidence-only fixture contracts
authority: Direct user request to create minimal authored fixtures, truth contracts, and tests for RR-COHORT-CURVE-001, RR-PERCENT-CHARGES-001, RR-COMPOSITE-001, and RR-SEGMENT-OVERRIDE-001 without external sources.

intent.productGoal: Make bounded revenue-recognition observations reproducible without converting fixture facts into selected methods, QoR adjustments, or professional conclusions.
intent.capability: Provide four minimal synthetic intake populations with explicit post-run truth contracts and regression assertions for the evidence-only boundary.
architecturalIntent: Intake facts, post-run truth contracts, method selection, adjustments, and professional conclusions remain separate objects.
Truth contracts are excluded from intake and source evidence is never rewritten to force a result.
invariants: All four fixtures retain an evidence_only truth state.
Automatic normalization is zero for every fixture.
Composite signals are not blended or double counted and segments are not overridden automatically.
acceptanceEvidence: JSON-schema validation of this conformance record.

decisions.decision: Represent each requested concept as a post-run truth contract rather than an analytical-method implementation.
decisions.rationale: The direct request is bounded to authored fixtures/contracts/tests, and this preserves the evidence-only authority boundary.

observedBehaviour: The focused fixture regressions passed: each fixture's claims/payments population matched the post-run contract, truth contracts remained outside intake, and adjustmentTotal remained zero.
Core typecheck passed and this record validated against the stable conformance schema.

evidence.result: 43/43 tests passed, including six RR fixture-contract assertions.
Four synthetic fixtures provide only claims/payments intake populations; every truth contract is explicitly excluded from intake and specifies zero automatic normalization.

divergences.expected: An approved, run-bound method or professional decision may select a recovery approach or segment override in the future.
divergences.observed: No such selection or decision authority is created by these authored regression fixtures.

learning.recurringPattern: Observed rates and segment differences are evidence, not authority for an economic conclusion.
learning.improvementProposal: Introduce method-selection and professional-decision contracts only under separately authorized work with explicit lineage, eligibility, and approval semantics.
durableKnowledge: Post-run truth contracts must never be treated as intake sources.
A composite of signals must not silently select, weight, or double count evidence.
